messages:
marta: Quick sync — we have a short oral-history style interview scheduled with Peregrine Health next Tue 10am PT. Goal: 3 short quote pullouts and a 10-12 min customer audio clip for socials.
jack: Awesome. Who's handling recording + transcript?
jack: I can take recording if someone can do note-taking and quick transcript.
nina: I’ll run the interview guide and pull quote candidates live. Will also flag any potential compliance-y phrasing.
liam: Heads up — Peregrine asked for PR/legal review on quotes. Please route final quote snippets to me before publish.
marta: Noted. Plan: jack records, nina sends raw transcript to #marketing once done, then liam reviews snippets within 24h. Sound ok?
samoe: Can we also ask product for a short benchmark stat to include? e.g., latency/cost delta from our benchmark run last month. If so, ping @rachel from product ops.
rachel: I can supply a 1-2 sentence metric and a one-line blurb about integration. Will deliver by Mon EOD if needed.
jack: Recording checklist: Zoom local record, 48kHz stereo, backup Otter link, start with release waiver note. I’ll share the recording link in thread after.
nina: Interview guide draft (snippet):
- Quick intro (1m)
- Problem they had before Redwood (2m)
- Implementation & early wins (4m)
- Specific quote asks (2m)
- One sentence advice for peers (1m)
jack: Perfect. Add a question asking for measurable impact (e.g., % latency improvement or tokens savings).
marta: After call: nina to pull 5 candidate quote lines, tag them as "safe", "needs-liam", or "needs-edit". Then route to liam for legal clearance.
liam: Good. For legal: please include original transcript lines and a one-sentence context for each quote. I’ll aim to return edits + OK/no-OK within 24 hours. If something is high-risk, I'll flag it.
nina: Got it. One note — customer may want to keep a specific competitor name out of public quotes. I’ll flag those lines as sensitive.
marta: For launch planning: earliest publish date we can target is Fri 3/19. That gives us time for legal + design assets + a short blog.
jack: Asset list: short audio clip (<=12s), 3 quote cards, blog post draft, hero screenshot of product, short webinar CTA (optional).
nina: I’ll draft the blog and the tweet copy. Can we run the blog through an internal small eval for claims (numbers check)?
samoe: Yep — if you drop the stat from @rachel I’ll run a numbers sanity check and confirm wording.
rachel: Stat: "30-40% reduction in per-request cost with our batching+cache config" — feel free to paraphrase, but keep range.
liam: Legal ok on that phrasing as long as we include the timeframe (Q4 2025 test) and an internal note that it's based on internal benchmarks. Send my team the raw numbers if you want verbatim.
marta: Cool. Nina — aim to have first draft quotes + blog by Wed EOD. Jack — confirm recording link in thread after interview. I’ll create a short launch calendar invite and tag stakeholders.
nina: Will do. Also planning a short webinar tie — 20 mins with Peregrine as a guest for customers, draft CTA in the blog. Want to gauge interest first.
jack: Slack remind set: `/remind #marketing to review Peregrine quotes on Wed 10am` :alarm_clock: 
marta: Thanks — last thing: include a one-sentence embargo note at the top of the assets doc: "Do not publish before Fri 2026-03-19 9:00 PT."
liam: I'll review the embargo note; add contact details for legal in the assets doc.
nina: Recording done — uploaded link: https://drive.redwood/recs/peregrine-2026-03-10.mp3 (shared to marketing). Transcript attached in doc. I pulled 7 candidate lines and tagged 2 as sensitive.
jack: Received. Will make the 12s audio clip today and push the WAV to design.
nina: Sending candidate quotes now (short list):
- "Redwood cut our inference latency by half overnight." — needs-edit (mentions competitor)
- "We saw immediate cost savings in production after switching to dedicated pools." — safe
- "The rollout was seamless and the team was responsive every step of the way." — safe
liam: Reviewing quotes. First one: suggest edit -> "Redwood reduced our inference latency significantly in our production rollout." Marked OK with edit. Second & third are OK pending date/context.
marta: Liams edits accepted. Nina — please update the quote cards with the edited line and add the Q4 2025 benchmark parenthetical per legal.
nina: Done. Blog draft is in docs: https://docs.redwood/marketing/peregrine-case-draft — comments welcome.
samoe: Looked quick — CTA for webinar needs time/date option. Also recommend adding an image alt text and a short SEO title.
marta: Great. I’ll schedule the launch card on our calendar and notify sales for inbound lead routing — Sam, can you add the Pardot tag?
samoe: Yep — tag: `campaign=peregrine_2026_cs`, routing to SDR queue "mid-market-health".
jack: Design now has assets. I'll ping once quote cards live in Figma.
marta: Thanks everyone. Final reminder: route final assets to legal (liam) before publishing. If legal OK comes back by Thu EOD we can go live Fri morning. :rocket:
